summary: Frontend-only E2E validation of Pharmacy Smart Rx Request Builder (pharmacy 1670dufferin). Verified: login -> Pharmacy Hub -> Rx Requests -> New Rx Request, ROMERO search + PatientInfoPanel (name/DOB/address/cell/home/OHIP with 'Not available' fallback), 5-med paste => 5 separate pharm-med-card, edit panel + '+ More Rx Details' pharmacy fields (rx-number/days-supply/current-refills/med-note), review shows 5 separate rx-review-med rows, Send returns to list and new row appears, prior-requests section (rx-prior) with Repeat button copying 5 meds into new draft, pharmacy-unsaved-guard on nav click, rx-change-guard on 'Choose a different patient'. Physician side (staff@visita.demo since PAGUAYO login failed): /internal/rx queue shows the new PHARMACY row RX-000064 for ROMERO/Amlodipine/1670 Dufferin Drug Mart; detail modal renders 'Patient information (as sent)' (rx-patient-snapshot) with DOB/address/cell/OHIP and all 5 meds as separate structured rows. /internal/send-rx smoke check loads with no errors. All critical acceptance criteria for this feature pass.

issues: OHIP row shows raw digits '0000 000 111' (partially formatted). Health card version/expiry absent for this seed patient — expected fallback, but could be clearer with a 'no version' hint.

action_items: PAGUAYO physician credential (Newman2013_!) did NOT authenticate to /internal (fell back to staff@visita.demo which worked). If PAGUAYO is expected to log in, verify the seeded password / account status. Not blocking this feature.

Consider verifying single-med paste (single-card) and document-only PDF-only send flows in a follow-up run — this iteration exercised 5-med + prior/repeat but not the two smaller variants explicitly (backend already covers per iteration 46-52 handoff).
critical_code_review_comments: PharmacyRx.jsx is ~400 lines and manages many concerns (list, new builder, guard, drafts, prior requests). Consider extracting the new-request builder into its own component for maintainability (>300 lines in a single component).

PharmacyMedCard: `set('_moreOpen', !more)` stores UI-only state inside the med object; safer to keep _editing/_moreOpen in a parallel local map to avoid ever leaking into the submitted payload. Current code strips them in submit (line 175 of PharmacyRx.jsx) so it's OK today, but easy to regress.
Draft key uses sessionStorage without a size cap — if a pharmacy attaches many meds + long notes it should stay tiny, but no error surfaced if quota exceeded (silently caught).
